crossRefs.note: Now Naaman, captain of the army of the king of Syria, was a great man with his master, and honorable, because by him…
Now the king was talking with Gehazi the servant of the man of God, saying, “Please tell me all the great things that…
All the days in which the plague is in him he shall be unclean. He is unclean. He shall dwell alone. His dwelling shall…
“Command the children of Israel that they put out of the camp every leper, everyone who has a discharge, and whoever is…
Yahweh said to Moses, “If her father had but spit in her face, shouldn’t she be ashamed seven days? Let her be shut up…
If we say, ‘We will enter into the city,’ then the famine is in the city, and we will die there. If we sit still here…
“Why do we sit still? Assemble yourselves! Let’s enter into the fortified cities, and let’s be silent there; for Yahweh…
Why will you die, you and your people, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, as Yahweh has spoken…

translations.web: Now there were four leprous men at the entrance of the gate. They said to one another, “Why do we sit here until we die?
translations.bsb: Now there were four men with leprosy at the entrance of the city gate, and they said to one another, “Why just sit here until we die?
translations.kjv: And there were four leprous men at the entering in of the gate: and they said one to another, Why sit we here until we die?
translations.asv: Now there were four leprous men at the entrance of the gate: and they said one to another, Why sit we here until we die?
